value.main_text_excerpt:
Tone Haave
Tone Haave
LEADERSHIP MENTOR & CONSULTANT
You carry the responsibility.
Make room for perspective.
I work with leaders and established entrepreneurs navigating demanding decisions, growth, and change.
Our work gives you space to question familiar patterns, sharpen your judgement, and decide what deserves your attention next.
I believe the qualities that make us human are also what make us effective leaders.
Training you in the ability to think independently, question assumptions, exercise sound judgement, and take full responsibility for your most powerful decisions.
WORK WITH ME
PRIVATE MENTORSHIP
You’ve built something that works. Now you’re considering what comes next — for your business, your leadership, or yourself.
A private mentoring relationship where we examine the decisions, assumptions, and patterns shaping how you work. Bring the questions you find difficult to resolve alone, and leave with clearer priorities and practical next steps.
THE HUMAN EDGE
What does good leadership require when technology can do more of the work?
The drive to pursue something meaningful. The judgement to question an answer and make a considered choice. The empathy to understand how our decisions affect others. And the inspiration to imagine possibilities worth pursuing.
My interest lies at the intersection of people and technology: how we use AI while continuing to develop these human qualities — in ourselves, our leadership, and our organisations.
I welcome conversations about leadership development, workshops, and consulting that bring the human perspective into technological change.
LIMINA MASTERMIND
A small, carefully selected group for women who already lead, run businesses, and carry responsibility.
A place for honest conversations, thoughtful challenge, and perspectives beyond your own. We work with real decisions and ambitions, with each member taking ownership of what she chooses to do next.
A question worth your attention!
Some decisions keep returning, even when you’ve spent months thinking about them.
A Business Clarity Session is a focused, 75-minute conversation about a decision, challenge, or opportunity in your work. Together, we examine what is happening, question your assumptions, and identify a useful way forward.
Book one session, or choose three sessions for questions that benefit from continued exploration.
Experience that shapes my perspective
I founded my first business in 2006. Since then, I’ve built businesses, worked closely with people, and supported entrepreneurs and leaders through growth and change.
My background spans business ownership, health, and personal development. It has taught me to pay attention to both the demands of the work and the person carrying them.
I bring direct questions, careful listening, and a willingness to examine what has become familiar. My role is to help you see more clearly and make choices you can stand behind.

pages.title: Tone Haave Askeland | Leadership Mentor & Consultant

pages.main_text_excerpt:
HI, I’M TONE
For over two decades, my work has been shaped by a fascination with human behaviour, leadership, and what enables people to grow, make confident decisions, and thrive.
I founded my first business in 2006 and have spent the years since building companies, developing people, and navigating the realities of entrepreneurship. I understand what it means to carry responsibility, make difficult decisions, adapt to change, and turn ideas into results.
My professional background combines business development and entrepreneurship with extensive studies in human behaviour, health, and personal development. From sports science and biology to naprapathy, psychology-informed practices, meditation, and Human Design, my work has always centred on understanding people and what influences their capacity to perform, lead, and make sound decisions.
Today, I work with entrepreneurs, executives, and professionals who want to strengthen their leadership, navigate complexity, and create meaningful, sustainable progress. My approach combines strategic thinking, practical business experience, and a deep understanding of the human factors behind performance and decision-making.
Outside of work, I'm a mother of three, a lifelong learner, and someone who values nature, meaningful relationships, and a life that leaves room for more than achievement.
I believe the quality of our leadership is closely connected to the quality of our self-awareness. Understanding ourselves, recognising our patterns, and trusting our judgement are not simply personal qualities. They influence how we lead, the decisions we make, and the impact we have on others.
